concepts.why: The patient presented with a firm swelling in the posterior triangle of her left neck, torticollis, and an intra-muscular abscess in the left levator scapulae muscle, which are all consistent with an intramuscular abscess of the neck.

support_spans: Microbiological culture: F necrophorum infection, sensitive to co-amoxiclav
concepts.why: The patient's microbiological culture showed F. necrophorum infection, which is consistent with this diagnosis.

rationales.F01: Neck pain is a common symptom of intramuscular abscess of the neck.
rationales.F08: Firm swelling in the posterior triangle of the neck is a strong indicator of intramuscular abscess.
rationales.F12: Intra-muscular abscess in the left levator scapulae muscle is a definitive diagnosis of intramuscular abscess of the neck.
